# Charness

> Self-hosted Telegram (and Jira) bot that groups your Claude Code and OpenCode agent sessions by project instead of by chat, and keeps them reachable from anywhere, 24/7. A topic is a project or direction; its sessions live inside it, the topic's agent starts and watches them as their manager, and the bot runs their lifecycle.

Most agent apps split everything into sessions or chats, and tracking dozens of them over time gets very hard, while keeping a project or a direction in your head stays easy. Charness (formerly TelegramCode) adds a level of grouping above the session: a forum topic in Telegram is a project, sessions live inside it, the topic's agent starts and watches them as their manager, and the bot runs their lifecycle. The second idea is availability: it runs on your own machine or server and connects out to Telegram only, so there are no open inbound ports, and your agents are reachable from your phone at any hour. You bind each forum topic (or the bot's own DM) to a project folder and drive its OpenCode or Claude Code session by chat, voice, or file. Sessions survive both bot restarts and agent-server restarts. It supports voice input (Whisper), photo/file/PDF intake, scheduled prompts, pinned question alerts (a pin pierces a muted topic for exactly one notification), a raw `/terminal` shell, an agent-facing MCP so the agent can send back files/images/video and schedule itself, and 12 UI languages. MIT licensed, Node 22.12+, install with `npm install -g charness` (the command keeps the former name, `telegramcode`; `charness` works too).

## Project

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/olosegres/charness): source, issues, and releases (MIT license).
- [README](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#readme): full feature list, quick start, commands, and troubleshooting.
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/charness): install with `npm install -g charness` (Node 22.12+).
- [DEVELOPMENT.md](https://github.com/olosegres/charness/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md): architecture and local development.

## Key features

- [Two agent backends](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#common-any-surface): OpenCode (native server API over HTTP+SSE) and Claude Code (tmux and json-stream backends).
- [Projects, not chats](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#common-any-surface): a topic is a project or direction bound to a folder, with its sessions inside it and isolated from other topics; two topics can share a folder for parallel work.
- [Voice control](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#telegram): send a voice note, it is transcribed with Whisper and forwarded to the agent.
- [Scheduled and self-driving runs](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#scheduler-schedule-telegram): `/schedule` arms cron, one-shot, or N-times jobs per topic, and the agent can schedule itself.
- [Pinned question alerts](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#telegram): when the agent asks a question the bot pins it, so even a muted topic notifies you once.
- [Raw terminal](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#raw-terminal-terminal-telegram): `/terminal` binds a topic to a real shell in the project folder.
- [Restart-safe sessions](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#restart-behaviour): sessions survive both a bot restart and an agent-server restart.
- [Agent-facing MCP tools](https://github.com/olosegres/charness#bot-injected-agent-tools): the agent can send files, images, and video back to you, post multiple messages, and schedule itself.

## Install

- [Setup](https://github.com/olosegres/charness/blob/main/SETUP.md): `npm install -g charness`, put your bot token in one `.env`, launch from your projects folder, bind a topic; also Jira, and Docker as an alternative.
